{{Quote|I will let you pass.|The guard, after being [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]]|<ref name="Sphere of Influence">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>}}
A '''Neimoidian guard''' was on board the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Pantora)/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] in the [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|Blockade of Pantora]]. He was responsible for guarding the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Initially, he stopped [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] from passing. Tano used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] and the guard let her pass. He then stopped the senator so Ahsoka used another mind trick and they both progressed into the prison.
